conditional_requests.note: false_200 = a 200 whose body hash equals the previous body's. The server advertises validators it does not honour; Gate 5's bytes-saved claim rests here.

cadence.note: async re-poll fetches excluded; they would corrupt this distribution

last_modified_cadence.note: Derived from Last-Modified, so HEAD requests contribute. Independent of FeedHeader.timestamp and of payload cost.

payload_bytes.note: decompressed = post-transport-decompression wire bytes. Protobuf 'decoded size' is not a meaningful byte count and is not recorded.

churn.note: Churn answers how much write load a snapshot creates. Key persistence answers what dedup can key on, and is measured directly because a producer that restamps every entity saturates both churn figures and leaves their difference uninformative.

comparison_gap_seconds.note: Wall-clock separation of the snapshots each verdict is computed from. A verdict from snapshots minutes apart is weaker evidence than one from seconds apart; metrics.md must carry this, not present them as equal.

churn.finding: entity.id tracks the semantic key (ratio 0.99); it is usable as a dedup key on this feed. Raw id persistence is 99.2%, the remainder being genuine entity turnover rather than id instability.
